messages:
Kim (AE): Quick heads-up — HeliosBank wants a POC to migrate from Aureus API to Redwood. Their main asks: identical prompt/response parity, streaming support, and identical header-based auth. They're schedule-constrained, want a demo by next Tue.
Mika (Helios): yep, we need token-compat and minimal code changes. latency important too.
Raj (Eng): 👍 can we get an example request/response from Aureus? schema and auth header name.
Mika (Helios): sending sample in email, but quick example:
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer AUREUS_KEY
{
  "prompt": "Summarize...",
  "max_tokens": 512,
  "stream": true
}
```
response is a mixed JSON+chunk streaming with data:{...}

Selena (Product): Two product notes — 1) pricing ask: they expect parity with their current per-token billing. We should propose a migration credit + 10% discount on first 3 months. 2) We must clarify identical stop-sequence behavior.
Kim (AE): I'll surface discount. They also flagged fine-grained rate limits on workspace tokens.
Raj (Eng): On streaming: Redwood streams with SSE and `delta` chunks. If Aureus uses chunked JSON blobs, we can provide a slim shim that transforms Aureus-style chunks into our events. Example shim (node):
```js
// pseudo middleware to translate Aureus -> Redwood SSE
req.pipe(parseAureusChunks()).on('data', chunk => {
  const sse = `event: delta\ndata: ${JSON.stringify(chunk)}\n\n`
  sseSocket.write(sse)
})
```
This adds ~2ms per-chunk overhead.
Tariq (Security): Does Helios require encrypted keys in headers or HSM support? Also SOC2 + PCI posture questions incoming.
Mika (Helios): they have KMS + we need audit logs for any model inputs. Also data residency: EU-only processing for some workflows.
Raj (Eng): EU region ok — we can pin to eu-central. For KMS, we support customer-managed keys in Private/Dedicated; hosted needs a legal addendum. For POC we can use a temporary key and provide audit log sampling.
Selena (Product): Action items: (1) Raj — build a minimal compat shim repo + runbook for switching Auth header name `Authorization: Bearer` -> `X-Aureus-Token` mapping; (2) Kim — confirm discount and timeline with sales ops; (3) Tariq — start the security questionnaire draft.
Raj (Eng): I'll push a quick repo today. Initial plan: provide a drop-in sidecar container that rewrites headers and normalizes streaming. If they want full parity for edge cases (stop tokens & multi-turn session cache) we'll need 1 sprint of work.
Kim (AE): timeline check — demo next Tue means we need a working shim + sample app by Monday EOD. Raj, can you do a minimal demo w/ sample app using Helios sample payloads?
Raj (Eng): I can do Monday afternoon. Will need access to Helios sample keys or mocked tokens (Mika can provide). Also confirm expected SLA for the POC load — low concurrency ok?
Mika (Helios): low concurrency for POC (dev-only), can provide mocked keys.
Tariq (Security): I'll add the data-residency flag to questionnaire and note audit-log retention. One ask: will shim log raw prompts? we should avoid logging PII by default.
Raj (Eng): shim will not persist raw prompts; default redact strategy: keep hashes + metadata. We can demonstrate that in the demo.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: branch raj/aureus-shim -> staging at 2024-05-06T10:12:00Z :rocket:
Kim (AE): perfect. I'll coordinate calendar invites + get the legal contact for KMS addendum. Thanks team, I'll post customer availability here when confirmed. :thumbsup:
